title: Spanish Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Spanish-inspired stew loaded with rich vegetables. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic, cooking until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and prunes, continue to simmer for another 15 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
